description: Change a live transfer: title, message, expiry (later only, Pro/Team, at most 90 days after it was sent – get_transfer shows latest_possible_expiry) and the download password (set a new one, or remove it with remove_password). Only the fields you give change.

expires_at.description: Exact expiry as ISO 8601 (e.g. "2026-12-31T23:00:00Z"). Alternative to expires_in_days; same limits.

expires_in_days.description: Keep the files this many days from now (1–90). Pro/Team only, at most 90 days after sending; not for test keys. Leave out for the plan default.

id.description: Transfer id: the last part of the share link (https://pandafile.co/d/<id>), e.g. "k3x9q2m7ab".

password.description: Download password (8–200 characters). Recipients need it to download. Plus/Pro/Team only.

name: update_transfer
title: Update a transfer
